sections.title: Privacy notice
sections.body:
Effective 20 November 2026. This notice covers the NearPill website (nearpill.xyz), the pharmacy and administrator portals, and the NearPill Android app.

Who we are. NearPill is a drugstore finder with pickup ordering for Cebu City, Philippines, built as a student capstone project. "NearPill", "we" and "us" mean the project team: John Mark Guinita, Christian Andre Tanuco, Jannos Allabar and Kayezel Kate Rojo, Cebu City, Philippines. We decide how your personal data is used. Contact us at nearpillemail.business@gmail.com. Never send a password or code by email.

What we collect and why. Full name, email and password at sign-up, to create and secure your account (the password is stored only as a salted Argon2id hash, never as text). Email verification and reset codes, stored only as hashes and expiring. Your phone number, at profile or checkout, to place an order and for pickup. Cart and orders: pharmacy, medicines, quantities, amounts, pickup date and window, status and rejection reasons. A prescription photo when you order a prescription medicine. Payment records: amount, status and the provider's reference (card or GCash details typed on the provider's page go to the provider, not to us). Your messages to the Ask NearPill assistant. Security records (hashed session credentials, failed-login counts and IP address) to stop password guessing and revoke sessions. Audit records of account, order and partner actions, so errors and misuse can be traced.

How we use your data. To run your account, show pharmacies and stock, process orders and pickups, send verification, password and security emails, protect the service from abuse, and fix problems. We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.

Your location. Your location is used on your phone or in your browser to sort nearby pharmacies and draw the map. NearPill does not store your location on its server. When you open a route, your position is sent to Google to calculate it. You can turn location off in your device or browser settings; search still works, without distances.

Prescription photos. A prescription photo is shared only with the pharmacy you ordered from. A review that is still pending expires after 24 hours, and the photo is deleted once the pharmacy approves or rejects it. Bring the original prescription at pickup. Do not upload anything else in that photo.

The Ask NearPill assistant. When you send a message, our server passes it to Google's Gemini service, together with limited facts about your own orders, your cart and a few matching catalogue items, so it can answer. Our server holds the Gemini key, so it is never on your device. We do not store the conversation in our database, but Google processes it under Google's own terms. Do not type passwords, codes, payment details or health information. The assistant explains how to use NearPill only. It does not give medical advice.

sections.title: Who receives your data and how long we keep it
sections.body:
Who receives your data. We share data only as needed to run the service. The pharmacy you order from gets your name, phone, order details and prescription photo, to prepare your order and review your prescription. Supabase stores all account and order data in a managed PostgreSQL database (Singapore). Render hosts the service (Singapore region). Brevo sends verification codes, password and security emails. Xendit processes payments (Test Mode only for now) and gets the order amount and reference. Google provides maps, routes and the Gemini assistant, and gets map requests, route positions and assistant messages. Because some providers are outside the Philippines, your data may be processed abroad. We may also disclose data when the law or a court requires it.

How long we keep data. Prescription photos are deleted once the pharmacy decides, and pending ones expire after 24 hours. Web sessions last 8 hours, and verification and reset codes expire after a short time. Audit logs, sign-in security records and payment-event logs are kept for 3 months and then deleted automatically. Your orders and receipts stay in your order history while your account exists, and stay without your identity if you delete your account.

Deleting your account. You can delete your account in the app or on the website only when every order is completed (picked up) or cancelled. You cannot delete your account while an order is still waiting to be picked up. We then erase your name, email, phone number and password, and remove any prescription photos. Past orders and payment records stay, without your identity, so the pharmacy's and NearPill's records remain correct.

sections.title: Security, your rights and contact
sections.body:
How we protect your data. Passwords are hashed. Web sessions use a secure, HttpOnly cookie with CSRF protection. The Android app keeps your sign-in in the phone's secure storage. Prices, stock and order ownership are checked on the server, and every pharmacy action is limited to that pharmacy's own staff. After five failed sign-ins we notify you. No system is perfectly secure. If a breach puts your data at risk, we will tell affected users and the National Privacy Commission as the law requires.

Your rights. Under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act 10173) you may be informed about how your data is used, access it, correct it, object to its use, ask us to delete or block it, receive a copy, and claim damages if you were harmed. You may also complain to the National Privacy Commission. Write to nearpillemail.business@gmail.com from your account email. We may ask you to confirm who you are first, and we will answer within 1-7 business days.

Changes to this notice. When we make a change that matters, we update the date and version here and ask you to accept it again at sign-in. Using NearPill after that means you accept the change.

Contact. NearPill, John Mark Guinita, Christian Andre Tanuco, Jannos Allabar and Kayezel Kate Rojo, Cebu City, Philippines. Email: nearpillemail.business@gmail.com.

sections.title: Orders, cancellations and refunds
sections.body:
Ordering and pickup. One order covers one pharmacy. Items from other pharmacies are separate orders, each with its own payment and pickup. Choose a pickup date from today up to 7 days ahead (Philippine time), and optionally a window: morning 8 to 12, afternoon 12 to 5, evening 5 to 8. You can change the date once. If the pharmacy's opening hours can be read, pickup is not offered in the last 60 minutes before closing, and "any time" is not allowed for today. Stock is held for your order for a limited time. An unpaid or unclaimed order may be cancelled and the stock released. Show your claim code when you collect an order. You do not need to bring an ID.

Payments (Test Mode). NearPill currently runs payments in Xendit Test Mode. No real money is charged or moved. An order is marked paid only when the payment provider confirms it, never from a label on your screen. You may pay a deposit or the full amount. The deposit is the larger of PHP 100 or half of the total, and never the whole total; orders of PHP 100 or less must be paid in full. The balance is paid at pickup. NearPill charges no fees at present. If live payments are switched on later, we will update these terms and ask you to accept them again.

Cancellations and refunds. You can cancel an order from My Orders before it is prepared. Money you have already paid, whether a deposit or the full amount, is not refundable. An order you cancel before paying is simply cancelled. While payments are in Test Mode no real money is charged, so nothing is refunded.

sections.title: Terms and conditions
sections.body:
Effective 20 November 2026. By creating an account, ticking the agreement box or using NearPill, you agree to these terms and to the privacy notice. If you do not agree, please do not use NearPill.

What NearPill is. NearPill helps you find medicines and pharmacies in Cebu City, compare each pharmacy's own price and stock, reserve items and pick them up in store. NearPill is not a pharmacy. It does not sell, prepare or deliver medicine. Each partner pharmacy is responsible for its stock, prices, dispensing and pickup. NearPill is a student capstone project and may change, pause or stop at any time.

Your account. You must be at least 18 years old. Give accurate information and keep your password private. You are responsible for activity on your account. Verify your email with the code we send you. You can sign out of all devices or delete your account from the app or website. Tell us at once if you think someone else used your account.

No medical advice. NearPill gives information to help you find and order products. It does not diagnose, recommend treatments or tell you what to take or how much. Ask a pharmacist or doctor before you use any medicine. In an emergency, call your local emergency number or go to the nearest hospital. Do not rely on NearPill for urgent care.

Availability and prices. Prices are in Philippine pesos and are set by each pharmacy. Stock changes quickly, so a search result is not a guarantee. Quantity 1 means the unit the pharmacy actually sells (for example a tablet, sachet or box). Distances are estimates.

Prescription medicines. A prescription medicine cannot be ordered until you upload a prescription for that pharmacy and the pharmacy approves it. The pharmacist may reject a prescription and must give a reason. You must bring the original prescription at pickup, and the pharmacy may refuse to hand over the medicine if it does not match. You confirm that every prescription you upload is yours or was lawfully given to you, and that it is genuine.

The Ask NearPill assistant. The assistant is an AI tool that only helps you use NearPill. It can be wrong. It will not give medical advice, doses or safety opinions, and you should not rely on it for them. Use is limited to 20 requests per 10 minutes and 150 per day. Do not try to make it ignore its rules.

Pharmacy partners and subscription plans. Pharmacies join NearPill as partners on a Basic (3 months), Plus (6 months) or Pro (12 months) plan. Plans set the length of the partnership and access to sales reports: Plus shows the last 90 days and Pro shows the full history. Plans currently have no price and no billing. Partners must keep their prices, stock, opening hours and licences accurate, must review prescriptions properly, and must hand over orders only after checking the claim code. NearPill may suspend a partner that breaks these terms.

Acceptable use. You agree not to upload a false, altered or stolen prescription, or a photo that shows other people's data; place orders you do not intend to collect, or use another person's account; try to break, overload, scrape or reverse engineer the service, or bypass its security; or use NearPill for anything unlawful, or to harass pharmacy staff. We may suspend or close accounts that break these rules.

Our content and your content. The NearPill name, logo, design and software belong to John Mark Guinita. You may use the service for personal, non-commercial purposes. You keep ownership of what you upload, and you allow us and the pharmacy you ordered from to use it only to provide the service.

Disclaimers and limits. NearPill is provided "as is", without a promise that it will always be available, accurate or error free. To the extent the law allows, the NearPill team is not liable for medicine you buy from a pharmacy, for stock or price differences, for a missed pickup, for assistant answers, or for loss caused by outages or by things outside our control. Nothing here limits any right you have under Philippine consumer law that cannot be waived.

Ending your use. You may stop using NearPill and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or end access if you break these terms or if the service closes. The parts on acceptable use, content, and disclaimers stay in force afterwards.

Changes, law and contact. We may update these terms. We will show the new date and version and ask you to accept it again when the change matters. These terms follow the laws of the Republic of the Philippines. Disputes are brought in the proper courts of Cebu City. Questions: nearpillemail.business@gmail.com, NearPill, John Mark Guinita, Christian Andre Tanuco, Jannos Allabar and Kayezel Kate Rojo, Cebu City, Philippines.

sections.title: Cookies, browser storage and third parties
sections.body:
The website uses one session cookie to keep you signed in. The authenticated web portal uses a server-owned secure HttpOnly session cookie and a session-bound CSRF token. Your cart is kept in your own browser or phone storage, and editable browser storage is not an authorization source. The mobile app stores your sign-in in platform secure storage. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

When maps load, your browser loads them directly from Google, which receives your IP address and map requests under Google's terms, and fonts may load from Google as well. The website does not store your location on the NearPill server.
